name: Rin'ji's Secret
summary: In the Hinterlands, a tablet marked with Witherbark troll script may hold something valuable. Oran Snakewrithe in Undercity’s Magic Quarter is asked to decipher it.

sections.title: Troll Markings
sections.body: Rin'ji's Secret is a tablet found among the troubles of the Hinterlands. Its surface bears the markings of the Witherbark trolls, and its meaning is unknown. Oran Snakewrithe, a scholar of Witherbark matters in Undercity, may be able to read it.

faq.answer: Rin'ji's Secret is a tablet covered in Witherbark troll markings. Its meaning is a mystery.
Oran Snakewrithe, a scholar of Witherbark trolls in Undercity's Magic Quarter, may be able to decipher the tablet.
The tablet is tied to Rin'ji's troubles in the Hinterlands.
The tablet may be valuable, but its worth is uncertain until its markings are understood.

angles.text: The tablet bears Witherbark markings, so its mystery concerns the history and lore of a troll tribe.
